tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search hotels for this organization. Extract structured filters (city_name, rating_min, has_*) when present in the user request. Set limit (1 for "best", 2-3 for "top", 5 for some, 10 for broad).

city_name.description: Municipality / locality name. Accent-insensitive (Alcorcon == Alcorcón). Use the actual municipality, not the metro area (Alcorcón, not Madrid).

region.description: Soft hint for sub-locality / neighborhood / district. Treated as a ranking boost, not a hard filter. Use city_name for actual municipalities (including Madrid suburbs like Alcorcón).

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check real-time room availability and prices for specific hotels. Extract boardTypes and freeCancellationOnly from the user request when mentioned (e.g. "with breakfast" -> boardTypes: ["BB"], "all inclusive" -> ["AI"], "free cancellation" -> freeCancellationOnly: true). You MUST call this tool when the user asks to book, reserve, order, checkout, proceed with, or complete a previously discussed room. Reuse the latest hotelIds, dates, nights, guests, boardTypes, and freeCancellationOnly from the conversation or prior tool calls. The returned widget provides the booking or checkout flow; never redirect the user to the hotel or provider.

boardTypes.description: Filter to rate plans with this meal plan. RO = room only, BB = breakfast included, HB = half board, FB = full board, AI = all inclusive.

freeCancellationOnly.description: Only include rate plans with free cancellation.
